test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
Consider the given question and decide which of the following statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.

There are five-person P, Q, R, S, and T sitting on a bench facing towards north. Who is sitting in the middle of the line?

Statements:

I. P is sitting at extreme end of the bench.

II. S is not sitting in the centre of the line.

options.text: Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in either statements I alone or II alone are sufficient to answer the question.
Data in both statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.

solution:
Statements:

I. P is sitting at extreme end of the bench.

Statement I tells about the position of P.

So, this statement not concludes who is sitting in the middle.

II. S is not sitting in the centre of the line.

Statemebt II tells about position of S.

So, this statement not concludes who is sitting in the middle.

Neither of the statements tells about the positions of other persons, that is Q, R, and T. 

From both these statements, we can conclude that P and S do not sit in the middle of the line. it means that one of Q, R, and T sits in the middle of the line.

Hence, **Data in both statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.**
